en.hubeali:
A group of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Hassan Bin Al Sariy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Azān is recited slowly, but the Iqamah, flowingly’.
en.sarwar: 26. A group of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Hassan ibn al-Sariy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Adhan is said with Tartil (articulation slowly) and ‘Iqamah is said quickly.’”
